meta.name: connectivity-ip
meta.description: IP networking fundamentals for Zephyr RTOS. Covers IoT protocol selection (LwM2M, CoAP, MQTT), IP stack configuration and trimming (IPv4/IPv6, UDP/TCP), and professional SDK integration as Zephyr modules using West manifests. Trigger when building cloud-connected applications, optimizing network memory usage, or integrating external cloud SDKs.
